start_here: Say to your AI: "Get my booking ready to confirm." It runs tool:check-a-booking-is-ready, which checks the time is still open and answers the event to make, changing nothing.
no_lists_because: It keeps no list of its own: it works on the form_rows the pursuit database you name already holds, and a sitting is one row there.
instructions: 1. Name the pursuit database that holds the form rows, such as example_for_who_runs_it; the computer opens it with the login its vault holds.
2. Say what you want in plain words; your AI calls tools:run with tool tool:check-a-booking-is-ready and the input.
3. Read the answer and show it with the page's screen; the tool reads one sitting.
